pages.title: Soul state
pages.text: “Living energy glows inside the $(l:resources/beyond/soul_catcher)Soul Catcher$(/l), but is that its only form?”$(br2)A soul can be alive, become light, and be drawn to a crystal. Capture a creature with the Soul Catcher, then combine it with amethyst to create a Crystallized Soul.

pages.title: A soul in crystal
pages.text: Combining a soul with amethyst opens new possibilities. A Crystallized Soul lets you enter the Beyond if you have not yet earned the “King of the Beyond” advancement. It can also restore the durability of a damaged item when combined with it.$(br2)Combining a Crystallized Soul with a damaged item restores that item’s durability.
